media_kind_fields.name: media_kind_fields
media_kind_fields.value:
("media"."kind" = 'embed' and "media"."embed_url" is not null and "media"."embed_provider" is not null)
				or ("media"."kind" <> 'embed' and "media"."key" is not null and "media"."bucket" is not null)

booking_booked_needs_dp.name: booking_booked_needs_dp
booking_booked_needs_dp.value: "booking"."stage" not in ('booked', 'preparation', 'event_day', 'editing', 'completed') or "booking"."booked_at" is not null

booking_lost_needs_reason.name: booking_lost_needs_reason
booking_lost_needs_reason.value: "booking"."stage" <> 'lost' or ("booking"."lost_reason" is not null and btrim("booking"."lost_reason") <> '')

booking_session_time_format.name: booking_session_time_format
booking_session_time_format.value: ("booking_session"."start_time" is null or "booking_session"."start_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$') and ("booking_session"."end_time" is null or "booking_session"."end_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')
